items.title: Modular algal–bacterial co-culture published in Metabolic Engineering
items.body: A GYD1-deficient C. reinhardtii mutant feeds glycolate to E. coli in a two-stage continuous system, producing GFP and lycopene directly from CO2.

items.title: Yejin Lin completes her MS and joins Medytox
items.body: Congratulations to Yejin on finishing her master's degree in the lab and starting her industry career.

items.title: Review on methanol valorization in yeasts out in New Biotechnology
items.body: A lab-wide review with Prof. Jeong Chan Joo covering methanol assimilation, synthetic methylotrophy, and fermentation engineering for C1 biomanufacturing.

items.title: New genome engineering platform for K. phaffii published
items.body: Yujung and Ayoung's HR-enhanced chassis (Ku70Δ / RAD52 OE) reaches 68.1% integration with 50-bp homology arms, and assembles ten DNA fragments in vivo without E. coli cloning.
